保存请求超时，结果尚未确认。请重试或检查服务状态。: The save request timed out and the result is unconfirmed. Retry, or check the service status.
无法连接本地服务，修改已保留，请确认服务正在运行后重试。: Could not reach the local service. Your changes were kept; make sure the service is running and try again.
保存失败，修改已保留，请重试。: Save failed. Your changes were kept; please retry.
保存结果已确认；后续读取失败不能误报为保存失败。: The save result is confirmed; a later refresh failure must not be reported as a save failure.
设置已保存；状态刷新失败，稍后会自动重试。: Settings saved; refreshing the status failed and will be retried automatically.
调整本机推理与模型刷新，保存后生效。: Tune local inference and model refresh. Changes take effect after saving.
控制客户端调用与模型展示。: Control client access and model display.
关闭后暂停 API 推理，管理页面仍可访问。: When off, API inference is paused; the management pages stay reachable.
保留受当前出口地区限制的模型供客户端选择。: Keep models blocked by the current egress region available for clients to choose.
仅从选择器和 API 模型清单隐藏，保留历史模型调用。: Hidden from the selector and the API model list only; historical model calls are kept.
保留授权和历史模型调用，可随时恢复显示。: Authorization and historical model calls are kept; you can show them again at any time.
允许从已生成的检查点继续回答。: Allow answers to continue from the checkpoints already generated.
512–131072，实际输出还受模型能力限制。: 512–131072. Actual output is also limited by the model's capability.
管理模型清单的周期更新与探测。: Manage periodic updates and probes of the model list.
1–1440 分钟，保存后重新安排下一轮。: 1–1440 minutes; the next round is rescheduled after saving.
自动探测已关闭：周期刷新只更新模型清单，不会发送探测请求。: Automatic probing is off: periodic refresh only updates the model list and sends no probe requests.
自动刷新已启用，保存间隔后会重新安排下一轮。: Automatic refresh is enabled; saving the interval reschedules the next round.
当前以 --no-refresh 启动。设置会保存，但自动任务保持暂停；手动刷新: Started with --no-refresh. Settings are still saved, but the automatic task stays paused; manual refresh remains available.
配置保存在当前独立服务的数据目录中。页面读取和保存设置不会直接发送模型推理请求。: Configuration is stored in the data directory of the current standalone service. Reading and saving settings on this page never sends model inference requests.
